title_en: Chinese Humor (3/20): Tales from the Family Group Chat
note_en: 连……也/都…… means "even": 连 marks the surprising, extreme case, and 也 or 都 must follow before the verb. 连周末也不例外 "not even weekends are an exception"; 连一分钱的红包都抢得特别认真 "he grabs even a one-cent red envelope in dead earnest." English "even" is one word that can float around the sentence; Chinese needs both halves, with the "even" phrase placed before the verb.
